newsitem.title: CHINA: China '96 oil output seen hitting 155 mln T.
newsitem.headline: China '96 oil output seen hitting 155 mln T.

text.p: China's crude oil output is expected to total a record 155 million tonnes in 1996, the official People's Daily said on Sunday, quoting the China National Petroleum Corp.
Output this year had already hit 150 million tonnes by December 14, the newspaper said.
China produced a record 140 million tonnes of crude oil in 1995.
The newspaper said growing output for the whole of 1996 meant China would achieve its state-set production target for the year 2000 ahead of schedule.
The company attributed the increase to stable output in eastern China, and a dramatic increase in production from oilfields in western regions, it said.
The northeastern oilfield of Daqing accounted for 80 percent of total national output, it said, while northwestern Karamay was expected to produce more than eight million tonnes in 1996.
Offshore oil accounted for 9.5 percent of total output, the newspaper said.
